start:
In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Welcome to Natiq Quran Bot.

This bot is designed to deliver and display Quranic content and can send you random ayahs together with their translations.

Use the menu below to choose Random Ayah directly. You can also use /random to receive a random ayah and /help to view the command list.
help:
Natiq Bot Help

Available commands:
/start - Start the bot and show the main menu
/help - Show this help message
/random - Receive a random ayah
/admin - Open the admin settings area

Main menu buttons:
- Random Ayah: send a random ayah
- Admin Settings: open the administrative settings area (admins only)

Admin-only commands:
/reload_cache - Reload the Quran cache without restarting the bot

After receiving an ayah, the Next Ayah button will also appear when the messaging platform supports inline buttons.
admin_access_denied: You do not have access to the admin area. To enable this section, your numeric user ID must be included in the `ADMIN_USER_IDS` setting, or your database user record must have `is_admin` set to true.
admin_cache_reload_success: The Quran cache was reloaded successfully.
admin_cache_reload_failed: Reloading the Quran cache failed. Please check the bot logs.
rate_limited: You sent too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.
